```{r setup, include=FALSE}

source("replace_chunk.R")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```

### grab patient instances 
```{r}
patient_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  filter(grepl("a83c1bcc33", visit_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  collect() 
 
```

the patient has 8 totalvisits and only 4 of them are analyzed 
```{r}
patient_data<- patient_data%>% 
  select_if(function(x) !all(is.na(x))) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-visit_id, is.na))
```

### get ss assessments
```{r}
tbl_assess_raw <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select( visit_id, starts_with("spon")) %>% #, contains(c("grandftr_status"," grandftr_com", "")) 
  collect

tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id,  race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```

### clean up demo
```{r}
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) 
  
demographics <- demographics %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age))
```


```{r}
most_demo <-inner_join(patient_data, demographics , by = "visit_id") %>% 
  select(-c(ptid, shape, shape_num, diagnosis))
```

```{r}
most_demo %>%  summary() %>%  View()
```
### add assessments 
```{r}
most_info_ss <-inner_join(most_demo, tbl_assess_raw , by = "visit_id") 
```
